title: College football NIL means some rookies take pay cuts by going to the NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: College football NIL means some rookies take pay cuts by going to the NFL
sources.description: The ability of players to cash in on name, image and likeness deals has changed college football, and it also changes the reality of pro football for some rookies who will make less money in the NFL than they made in college.
